text:
Type: striped flatweave runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor; hallway, entryway, bedroom
Style: modern, rustic, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fabric, fine pinstripe texture
Colors: dark brown, warm beige, grey
Shape: long narrow runner, wide horizontal bands with thin pinstripes, thin flat weave, clean edges
Feel: grounded, warm, casual
Goes with: white floors, rustic wood, natural straw, plants; modern rustic or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Striped Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Beige
product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Add style to your entryway or hallway with this versatile, multi-colored runner. The simple stripes and neutral hues bring interest to your home while blending in with your existing style. Simple, eye catching striped design Hand loomed. Made in India. Wears well in high traffic areas 2'6" x 8' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
